Elephants use their trunks for many things. They use them to pull leaves off trees. They suck up water and spray it into their mouths to drink. They even wrap their trunks around their babies to guide them.

What is the main idea of this passage?
A) Elephants are gray
B) Elephants use their trunks for many things
C) Elephants like water

items.answer: B) Elephants use their trunks for many things

solution.answer: B) Elephants use their trunks for many things

solution.answer: B) Their thick fat keeps them warm

Helen Keller could not see or hear, but she never stopped learning. Her teacher spelled words into her hand until Helen understood language. Helen went on to graduate from college. She wrote books and traveled the world to help others with disabilities.

A) Helen Keller had a teacher who spelled words.
B) Helen Keller could not see or hear.
C) Even though Helen Keller could not see or hear, she learned language, went to college, and helped others.
D) Helen Keller wrote several books.
items.answer: C) Even though Helen Keller could not see or hear, she learned language, went to college, and helped others.

steps: A good summary gives the main idea plus the most important details.

Choice C ties the main idea and key details together, so C.
solution.answer: C) Even though Helen Keller could not see or hear, she learned language, went to college, and helped others.

At first, people threw their trash into open piles near town. Rats moved in, and the smell spread sickness. Later, cities dug covered pits to bury the waste. Today, modern landfills line the ground with thick plastic so poisons cannot leak into the water, and some even capture gas from the trash to make electricity.

What is the main idea of this passage?
A) Rats spread sickness in old towns
B) The way people handle trash has improved over time to keep us safer
C) Landfills use plastic liners
D) Trash can be turned into electricity
items.answer: B) The way people handle trash has improved over time to keep us safer

steps: The passage traces trash handling from open piles to modern landfills.
Choices A, C, and D are each only one detail.
The main idea is the overall improvement over time, so B.
solution.answer: B) The way people handle trash has improved over time to keep us safer

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

The little brown bat eats thousands of insects in a single night, including mosquitoes that bite people and pests that harm crops. Because bats eat so many pests, farmers do not have to use as much bug spray. This saves money and keeps harmful chemicals off our food. Yet a disease has killed many bats, and scientists worry about what their loss would mean.

Which is the best summary of this passage?
A) Bats fly at night and live in caves.
B) Bats eat many harmful insects, which helps farmers and people, so their loss to disease is worrying.
C) Mosquitoes bite people and spread itchiness.
D) Farmers use bug spray on their crops.
items.answer: B) Bats eat many harmful insects, which helps farmers and people, so their loss to disease is worrying.

steps: A good summary captures the main idea and the most important details.
Choices A, C, and D each mention only a small piece.
Choice B combines the main idea, why bats help, and the concern about disease, so B.
solution.answer: B) Bats eat many harmful insects, which helps farmers and people, so their loss to disease is worrying.
